remarks: Rarely do you find a property that has it all: a spacious move-in ready house with a pool, and a private one-acre parcel close to everything Darien has to offer. Tucked away at the end of a cul-de-sac, steps away from the newly reimaged town center, and close to beaches, this thoughtfully renovated 5 bed/4.5 bath home strikes just the right balance between comfortable living and sophistication. With tons of natural light, the first floor features an open living/dining room with access to the deck overlooking the pool, a kitchen with cozy banquette, family room with built-in desks and shelving, and a mudroom with laundry and custom cubbies. There are 4 spacious bedrooms and 3 baths upstairs, including a luxurious primary suite with vaulted ceiling, office, and generous walk-in closet and bathroom. The 5th bedroom, and 4th full bath, are in the walkout lower level which also offers a large "hang out" room with plenty of space for both relaxing and working out. For the car enthusiast, the detached barn, with heat and A/C, has an additional 2 garage bays as well as a workshop. Surrounded by nature, and awash with lush gardens, this is an unexpected oasis in the center of town.
